The experience at this clinic is, without a doubt, exemplary and extremely caring. We experienced family moments that only a professional like Dr. Bárbara Tomaras could provide. Our bunny, Tambor, will remain in our family forever, and we are deeply grateful for the memories we have created. The entire team is exceptional and tirelessly available.

I highly recommend them! My 6-year-old rabbit needed urgent dental work, and the entire process at Be Exotic was exemplary. A very special thank you to Dr. Bárbara Tomaras for her exceptional availability in adjusting her schedule and arriving early to be able to see him and perform the procedure on the same day. Communication throughout the entire stay was impeccable, keeping me informed at every stage (tests, start of sedation, and recovery). Professionalism, technical rigor, and genuine affection for exotic animals. I was very relieved knowing he was in the best hands. Thank you for everything!

As if that invaluable help at such a late hour wasn't enough, she messaged me first thing in the morning to check on him. Rare empathy and professionalism. Thank you so much for everything!

They explained very well how to care for her at home, which helped with her recovery. In addition, they even sent a WhatsApp message asking how she was doing, which shows that they are very attentive and truly care about the well-being of the animals! I highly recommend them!!!

After months without answers at another clinic, I brought my bird to this team specializing in exotic animals. I was treated with kindness, professionalism, and a genuine concern in finding out what was wrong with Tico. They explained everything clearly, were careful in the examinations, and treated him with great gentleness. The doctor also very sensitively alerted me to the possibility of Tico being female, something unexpected, but said in the best way. Regardless, he will always remain Tico.
I felt confident and relieved.

I highly recommend them.

I also want to thank the team who, even though we didn't see them, ended up taking care of and giving attention to our babies. Highly recommended. Dr. Bárbara and her staff are the best. I drove over 2 hours just so my mini pigs could receive a comprehensive and caring exam. Her practice is modern and stylish, but more importantly she is exceedingly knowledgable about mini pigs and thoughtful in her approach. We covered all aspects of my piglet's care and health. They were coaxed onto the scales with treats and the entire exam took place at their level (on the floor) with a gentle touch. There was no stress involved. She will be our "go to" vet for our little pigs - the distance is no issue, she is worth the travel time. Oh, and she is fully fluent in English, which helps as my Portuguese does not extend to veterinary appointments yet. Thank-you, Be Exotic! We will see you again!

I recommend them 100%. The entire clinic team is super professional. Fast and impeccable service. They treat all two-legged and four-legged patients with so much love and care. The patients are very grateful! 🫠 …

Incredible service, from the friendliness to the professionalism! I come with my rabbit, a Bellier, and I wouldn't choose a better clinic 💛 …

I didn't like it.
They cared for the animal (in this case, a turtle that had a broken shell) successfully up to that point.
From my point of view, I found it excessively zealous, which resulted in a significant increase in the bill.
From a broken shell, then possible lung injuries and even pneumonia.
Overnight stays, food, payment of €20 to remove a probe (something unprecedented, paying for the removal of something that had been placed) and payment of 11 tenths related to the procedure related to gluing the shell (something even more unprecedented, all my life I thought a unit was worth 10 tenths).
Surely there are medical reports justifying all the procedures.
Anyway, I won't be back.
Thanks!

In this last appointment with Veggie, I can only thank Dr. Bárbara for her availability to come and do a last-minute cleaning and the tireless Dr. Beatriz for her fight with the care and treatment of a serious illness, a blockage that could have led to my boy's death. 1000/10!

Despite everything, the team was excellent, explaining all the procedures that were being done, they were very humane, and in the end, they even gave us a souvenir of my Rio. Support was abundant. I will certainly return with my other birds.

There are no words to describe my experience at Be Exotic. The professionalism towards our animals and the humanity and care for the owners are outstanding. Being a veterinarian isn't just about dealing with animals; it also involves knowing how to deal with the feelings of the owners and what they may be going through. At Be Exotic, nothing was lacking. From the clinical and meticulous study of my bunny's health to the almost 24-hour monitoring, nothing was missing. Dr. Bárbara does it out of love; the passion is visible in her eyes. Believe me, it's very rare to find a doctor like Dr. Bárbara. She doesn't just fill our animals with medication for the sake of it; she always wants their well-being above any profit. She even went outside of working hours to see my Charles and never neglected his care, even making a trip to the clinic on a day she was off with her family. Dr. Beatriz was also essential in detecting the evolution of my boy's health condition, being crucial for his survival. As for the assistant Rita, she was a sweetheart who always warmed my heart. The Be Exotic team is exceptional and loves what they do. I will never have enough words to thank you for saving the life of the one who is my everything in this world. I recommend Be Exotic without hesitation, and Dr. Bárbara is truly exceptional. 💖 Now he is at home enjoying life with his canine brother Puma 💖 Thank you for making this possible.

Despite the less-than-ideal outcome, praise is due to the professionalism with which we were treated and the care shown by Pintas, down to the smallest detail of the souvenir that was given at the end. They make all the difference.
Thank you! I'm so glad you had a good experience at our clinic ❤️

I took my bunny to Be Exotic because of an abscess, everything went perfectly, but if it had been a more serious case, I would have gladly left her with 100% confidence in the clinic's professionals. They are very kind, gentle, and attentive! The facilities are fantastic and the price is affordable. Despite living about an hour away, I won't think twice about which exotic animal veterinarian to return to. For anyone considering where to take their pet, I absolutely recommend this clinic.
A special thank you to Dr. Beatriz and the nurses who attended to us, they were impeccable, as the rest of the team certainly will be. A kiss from Malva! 🐰💜
